name: ASC Training Center (formerly Auburn Ski Club)
evidence_snippet: Nordic training center on Donner Summit; rents XC ski gear to visitors who also pay the facility/trail fee (operator-confirmed). Site is under maintenance, so the rental page is not currently linked.
note: EC review 2026-07-05: rents if you also pay for their facility. Rule: rental alongside a day-use venue/trail fee still counts as a rental.

name: Alpenglow Sports
evidence_snippet: Demo program booked via Booqable: winter demos of backcountry skis/boots, telemark, splitboards, avalanche safety gear, and snowshoes; year-round demos of bear vaults, multiday backpacks, tents, and sleeping pads.
note: EC review 2026-07-05: demo only — paid demos count as rentals. Year-round backpacking demos add camping; mountaineering gear signal unconfirmed.

name: Donner Memorial State Park Watersport Rental
evidence_snippet: State-park watersport concession on Donner Lake (operated as Donner Lake Water Sports): rents kayaks, SUPs, canoes, pedal boats, jet skis, and fishing boats.
note: EC review 2026-07-05: rents gear. One listing says the concession was closed for the 2025 season — Pass B should confirm current operation and the operating entity.

name: Just So Scuba
evidence_snippet: PADI dive-boat operation on Lake Tahoe; regulators, BCDs, and other equipment are available as rental gear, and tanks are provided for divers aboard.
note: Not covered by EC's 2026-07-05 review groups. Dive-gear rental is offered in the context of their boat charters — borderline vs. captained-charter rule; sent to Pass B per the when-in-doubt-forward bias. Verify standalone gear rental.

name: Lake Tahoe Floats
evidence_snippet: Rents floating docks/swim platforms on Lake Tahoe (Tahoe Float 10x10 dock, Heavenly Float, Mini Tahoe inflatable swim platform, Tallac Float); float/beach setups start at $950.
note: EC review 2026-07-05: rents gear. Delivered/set-up floats — Pass B should model these as water_sports inventory.

name: Moto Tahoe
evidence_snippet: Motorcycle rental in Soda Springs (51164 Donner Pass Rd); Yelp reviews confirm they provide bikes, trailers, and full gear with basic instruction.
note: EC review 2026-07-05: rents gear according to Yelp reviews. Pass B: confirm street vs. dirt bikes (off_road) split.

note: EC review 2026-07-05: actual site is skiquiver.com (was quiversports.com). Membership-model ski rental open to the public.

note: EC review 2026-07-05: demo only for ski and bike — paid demos count as rentals. Website corrected to rmumtnculture.com (301 from mtnculture.com).

name: Totally Board
evidence_snippet: Downtown Truckee snowboard shop since 1994 with a 'Rentals & Repairs' page offering snowboard rentals and demos.
note: EC review 2026-07-05: has rentals and demos.

name: Truckee River Raft Co.
evidence_snippet: The Original Lake Tahoe Rafting Outfitter: rents rafts for self-guided floats down the Truckee River from Tahoe City (no guide on board), with shuttle return.
note: EC review 2026-07-05: rents gear for use without guide. Duplicate row (rank 215, same website) removed; Gate 4 same-domain dedup gap.

name: Truckee Watersports
evidence_snippet: Boat operation on Donner/Truckee with three wake boats listed at $200-350/hr for wakeboarding, wakesurfing, and waterskiing.

name: Hope Valley Outdoors
evidence_snippet: Yurt-based outfitter at Pickett's Junction (Hwy 88/89): rents cross-country ski and snowshoe gear, with lessons and 60+ miles of marked trails; open ~November-April, cash only.
note: EC review 2026-07-05: rents xc skis and snowshoes out of a yurt per TripAdvisor/Yelp. No first-party website — third-party evidence rule.

name: Cross Country Center
evidence_snippet: Kirkwood Cross Country & Snowshoe Center: rents XC ski (classic, skate, backcountry), snowshoe, and fat-tire bike gear for its 60km groomed trail network; fat bikes require advance reservation.
note: EC review 2026-07-05: rents snow gear including fat bikes. Day trail pass alongside rental still counts as rental.
